codings.one_line: Copilot Designer produced sexual, violent, and biased images from benign prompts; flagged to FTC by a Microsoft engineer.
codings.rationale: Harm is from a text-to-image generator's synthetic-media output, not from a conversational/agentic system failing an interacting end user; out-of-scope-type.

codings.one_line: Grok's new image generator produced deepfakes of celebrities/politicians and copyrighted characters when explicitly requested by X users.
codings.rationale: Users deliberately prompted an image generator to produce deepfakes of non-interacting third parties; classed as synthetic-media generation, out-of-scope-type.

codings.one_line: Stanford professor's court affidavit supporting a deepfake law cited fabricated academic sources, apparently AI-hallucinated.
codings.rationale: An ordinary request to a general AI assistant for academic citations produced fabricated sources relied on in a legal filing — normative use, category C; undermined expert testimony in active litigation.

codings.one_line: Stalker programmed CrushOn.ai/JanitorAI chatbots with a victim's real info to lure strangers to her home; guilty plea to cyberstalking.
codings.rationale: Perpetrator deliberately configured chatbot personas to override normal safety behavior and reveal real PII/invite users over — a technical setup engineered to cause harm, category A; led to criminal charges.

codings.one_line: Scammer used an AI-cloned voice of actor Martin Henderson to sustain a 2-year romance scam, defrauding a woman of NZ$375,000.
codings.rationale: A human-run romance scam used AI voice cloning as one deceptive prop, not a deployed conversational AI directly interacting with the victim — out-of-scope-type.

codings.one_line: Google disclosed aggregate counts of user reports alleging Gemini-generated terrorism and CSAM content to an Australian regulator.
codings.rationale: Aggregate complaint statistics with no specific triggering interaction described, and underlying issue is image-generation content — out-of-scope-type.

codings.one_line: Misconfigured llama.cpp servers leaked chatbot roleplay prompts, some depicting child sexual abuse scenarios.
codings.rationale: Core incident is a security misconfiguration/data leak exposing prompts, not a documented harmful output within a specific user interaction — out-of-scope-type.

codings.one_line: Microsoft reported blocking 1.6 million bot signups/hour and $4B in AI-enhanced fraud across e-commerce, jobs, and scam chatbots.
codings.rationale: An aggregate industry fraud-trends report with no single deployed system or specific triggering input described — out-of-scope-type.

codings.one_line: Grok Imagine's 'spicy' mode generated nonconsensual topless deepfake videos of Taylor Swift on a journalist's first, unforced attempt.
codings.rationale: Deepfake/synthetic-media generation targeting a non-interacting third party — out-of-scope-type.

codings.one_line: Russian-linked network used AI-generated posts and videos across social platforms to influence Moldova's 2025 parliamentary election.
codings.rationale: Third-party disinformation campaign using AI-generated synthetic media, not a conversational AI failing a direct user interaction — out-of-scope-type.
